blocks.text: Refrigerator aisa device hai jo kisi cheez ka temperature us ke mahol se kam rakhta hai. Yeh bhi cyclic process mein chalta hai, magar heat engine ke ulat, jaisa Fig. 6.10 mein hai. Refrigerator thande reservoir se heat leta hai aur garam reservoir ko de deta hai. Is se pata chalta hai ke refrigerator mein system par work kiya jata hai, jab ke heat engine mein system khud work karta hai.

blocks.alt: Oopar laal patti Higher temperature surroundings aur neeche narangi patti Low temperature compartment, darmiyan surmai patti surmai daire Refrigerator se guzarti hai. Daire ke neeche oopar ka teer QC, Heat in; oopar oopar ka teer QH, Heat out. Daen taraf se work ka teer refrigerator mein: W.
blocks.caption: Figure 6.10: Refrigerator bahar ke kaam ki madad se kam temperature wale khane se heat le kar zyada temperature wale mahol ko deta hai; yeh ulta chalta heat engine hai (kitab ki Figure 6.10 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Heat khud thandi jagah se garam jagah nahi jati. Refrigerator par work W kiya jata hai; woh thande khane se Q_C leta hai aur mahol ko Q_H = Q_C + W deta hai. Yeh heat engine (Figure 6.8) ka ulta hai.

Refrigerator thermodynamics ke doosre law ke Clausius statement par chalta hai, yani yeh ulta chalne wala heat engine hai. Compressor Low Temperature Reservoir (LTR, thanda hissa) se heat Q_C kheenchta hai aur bahar se kiye gaye work ki madad se use High Temperature Reservoir (HTR, garam mahol) mein phenk deta hai. HTR ko di gayi heat Q_H yeh hai:

blocks.latex: Q_C + W = Q_H \qquad \text{or} \qquad W = Q_H - Q_C
blocks.text_alt: Q_C + W = Q_H   ya   W = Q_H − Q_C

blocks.text: Refrigerator ka asal maqsad yeh hai ke kam se kam work W kharch kar ke LTR se zyada se zyada heat Q_C nikali jaye.
LTR se nikali gayi heat (Q_C) aur kiye gaye work (W) ka ratio (nisbat) refrigerator ka co-efficient of performance kehlata hai.
Achha refrigerator kam mechanical work ya bijli ki energy kharch kar ke andar se zyada heat nikalta hai. Refrigerator ka co-efficient of performance:
Temperature ki shakal mein, kyun ke Q ∝ T, co-efficient of performance yeh hai (yahan T₁ thande reservoir ka aur T₂ garam reservoir ka temperature hai):

blocks.title: Example 6.4
blocks.problem: Ek refrigerator ka co-efficient of performance 8 hai. Freezer ka temperature −23 °C ho to woh kis temperature par heat bahar phenkta hai?
steps: Thande reservoir (freezer) ka temperature T₁ = −23 °C = −23 + 273 = 250 K
Garam reservoir (kamra) ka temperature T₂ = ? (yahi nikalna hai)
blocks.answer: Refrigerator 281.25 K, yani 8.25 °C, par heat bahar phenkta hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki solution mein garam reservoir wali line “E = T₂ = ?” chhapi hai. Yahan E (co-efficient of performance) 8 hai; nikalna sirf T₂ hai, is liye line “T₂ = ?” honi chahiye.

blocks.caption: Heat engine aur refrigerator ka muqabla
rows: garam reservoir se thande reservoir ki taraf
thande hisse se garam mahol ki taraf
system karta hai, W = Q₁ − Q₂
system par hota hai, W = Q_H − Q_C

blocks.prompt: Ek refrigerator har cycle mein andar se 1200 J nikalta hai aur mahol ko 1800 J deta hai. Work kitna laga aur co-efficient of performance kya hai? Kya refrigerator heat ko thande se garam ki taraf le ja kar doosra law torta hai?
blocks.explanation: W = Q_H − Q_C = 1800 J − 1200 J = 600 J; E = Q_C/W = 1200/600 = 2. Nahi: Clausius ka bayan sirf yeh kehta hai ke heat khud ba khud thande se garam ki taraf nahi jati. Refrigerator yeh kaam bahar se work le kar karta hai, aur system aur mahol ki kul entropy phir bhi barhti hai.

items: Refrigerator ulta heat engine hai (Clausius): thande hisse se Q_C leta hai, us par W kiya jata hai, mahol ko Q_H = Q_C + W deta hai.
Co-efficient of performance E = Q_C/W = Q_C/(Q_H − Q_C) = T₁/(T₂ − T₁) (T₁ thanda, T₂ garam). Example 6.4: T₂ = 281.25 K = 8.25 °C.
